assign.outcome: **Layout categorized: three real shells, not eleven patterns.** Surveyed 20 pages × 390/1280/3440 (60 rows, `layout-survey.json`) against `ext/DesignTool/library`. Finding: only **Rail and content** (13/20 — home, /framework/*, /blog/, /michael/*), **Docs three-region** (rail+prose+TOC, every blog post), and **Columns row/Finder** (5/20 — all of /imagine/, core/Page's columns demos) are ever a real page's own shape; **Solo/bespoke** (/resume/) is the one outlier. The library's other patterns (tile wall aside) are CONTENT inside those shells, or — for Dashboard row, Media gallery, List-and-detail, Wide table, Section band — exist ONLY as boxed mockups on styles/layouts/* doc pages, never as a live page's own layout. Clearest failures, all dead-space not breakage: `/imagine/gallery/` and `/imagine/design/` stuck at 13% of a 3440 screen at every width measured (grade F); `/imagine/` itself drops 88%→39% width_used past its columns-host default column; `/michael/` and `/michael/layout/` (rail-and-content) drop similarly (45%→19%, 79%→33%) hitting their prose ceiling with nothing added beside it. No page in the sample overflowed, clipped or scrolled sideways at any width. Handoff for the system proposal: (1) a columns-host column can't say "grow with the row", (2) rail-and-content has a ceiling and no declared second act, (3) nothing measures its own width_used and reacts.
